sports.body: India's Kamaljeet and Suruchi Inder Singh won the gold medal in the 10m air pistol mixed team event at the Asian Games 2026 on Friday. The Indian pair finished on top at the Aichi General Shooting Range to give India its second gold medal of the Games. The gold medal is India's second at the ongoing Asian Games. India's women's cricket team had earlier won the first gold medal after beating Sri Lanka in the final.
